decision_thresholds.challenge.label: Challenge threshold
decision_thresholds.challenge.description: Minimum score for medium risk. Outcome is usually challenge (Turnstile, MFA, manual review) instead of allow.
decision_thresholds.challenge.example: 40 — a player with score 39 is allow; score 40+ is challenge unless a hard-block signal fired.

decision_thresholds.high.label: High threshold
decision_thresholds.high.description: Minimum score for high risk. Login/signup often block; deposits/withdrawals/bets may block or need extra checks.
decision_thresholds.high.example: 61 — score 60 stays medium/challenge; score 61+ is high risk.

decision_thresholds.block.label: Block threshold (critical)
decision_thresholds.block.description: Minimum score for critical risk. Usually results in block unless a hard-block signal on the Decision tab already forced block.
decision_thresholds.block.example: 85 — score 84 may still be high; score 85+ is critical/block.

operator.platform_name.label: Platform name
operator.platform_name.description: Internal label for this operator instance. Used in logs and audit entries — not sent to players.
operator.platform_name.signal: unlicensed_jurisdiction (when country not in licensed markets)

operator.licensed_markets.label: Licensed markets
operator.licensed_markets.description: Countries where you hold a gambling licence. Select from the list — checked on signup, deposit, and bet using player country or IP geo.
operator.licensed_markets.example: Select DE, GB, MT, SE — a player from FR with no licence raises unlicensed_jurisdiction.

ip_intel.enabled.label: Enabled
ip_intel.enabled.description: Master toggle. When off, no external IP lookups run and no vpn/proxy/tor/hosting signals are emitted.
ip_intel.enabled.example: Off during local dev if you don't want outbound API calls.

ip_intel.cache_ttl_seconds.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
ip_intel.cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long each IP lookup result is cached in Redis or memory before re-fetching.
ip_intel.cache_ttl_seconds.example: 3600 — same IP checked once per hour; lowers API usage but VPN toggles may lag up to 1 hour.

ip_intel.timeout_seconds.label: Lookup timeout (seconds)
ip_intel.timeout_seconds.description: Max wait per external IP API request. Affects evaluate latency when cache misses.
ip_intel.timeout_seconds.example: 2.0 — fail or fail-open quickly; 5.0 — more time for slow APIs.

ip_intel.fail_open.label: Fail open on lookup error
ip_intel.fail_open.description: When on, API timeout/error does not add risk. When off, lookup failure is treated as suspicious (VPN/proxy suspected).
ip_intel.fail_open.example: On in production if IP API downtime must not block logins; off if you prefer strict behaviour.

aml.single_deposit_threshold.label: Single deposit review
aml.single_deposit_threshold.description: Single payment.deposit at or above this amount triggers compliance review tier 1.

aml.large_deposit_threshold.label: Large deposit review
aml.large_deposit_threshold.description: Highest deposit AML tier — for very large single deposits.

aml.withdrawal_review_threshold.label: Withdrawal review
aml.withdrawal_review_threshold.description: Single payment.withdraw at or above this amount triggers cashout review signals.
aml.withdrawal_review_threshold.example: 1000 — withdrawal of €1,000 raises elevated_withdrawal_review and cashout_review_required.

aml.structuring_threshold.label: Structuring threshold
aml.structuring_threshold.description: Flags deposits between 90% and 100% of this amount — pattern used to stay just under reporting limits.

aml.micro_deposit_max.label: Micro deposit max
aml.micro_deposit_max.description: Deposits strictly below this amount trigger bonus-farming / payment-testing detection.

aml.high_stake_bet_threshold.label: High stake bet
aml.high_stake_bet_threshold.description: Single wallet.bet / game.bet at or above this amount. Bets above €100 (fixed engine rule) also raise elevated_stake_bet.

aml.blocklist.enabled.label: Blocklist screening enabled
aml.blocklist.enabled.description: Master toggle for all AML blocklist engines (crypto, bank, country, etc.).
aml.blocklist.enabled.example: Off only if you run blocklist checks entirely outside AFS.

aml.blocklist.crypto_enabled.label: Crypto wallet screening
aml.blocklist.crypto_enabled.description: Check crypto payout addresses on payment.withdraw / payment.deposit against OFAC sync + manual list.
aml.blocklist.crypto_enabled.example: Send payment_method_type: crypto and payment_method_key: 0xabc… on withdraw evaluate.

aml.blocklist.bank_enabled.label: Bank account screening
aml.blocklist.bank_enabled.description: Check IBAN/bank account ids on bank payouts.

aml.blocklist.ewallet_enabled.label: E-wallet screening
aml.blocklist.ewallet_enabled.description: Check e-wallet ids or emails on e-wallet payouts.

aml.blocklist.card_enabled.label: Card payout screening
aml.blocklist.card_enabled.description: Check card tokens or payout references on card withdrawals.

aml.blocklist.country_enabled.label: Country blocklist screening
aml.blocklist.country_enabled.description: Block signup/login/deposit/withdraw when player country matches OFAC sync, Lists tab, or manual countries.
aml.blocklist.country_enabled.example: Player country KP with country blocklist enabled → blocklisted_country.

aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_crypto_enabled.label: Auto-sync OFAC crypto wallets
aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_crypto_enabled.description: Pull U.S. Treasury SDN crypto addresses daily. Requires outbound HTTPS from Risk container.
aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_crypto_enabled.example: Use Sync OFAC lists now button below after enabling.

aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_countries_enable.label: Auto-sync OFAC countries
aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_countries_enable.description: Load Treasury-derived sanctioned country ISO codes into Postgres on each sync.
aml.blocklist.sync_ofac_countries_enable.example: Runs on schedule (sync interval) and on manual sync.

aml.blocklist.sync_interval_hours.label: Sync interval (hours)
aml.blocklist.sync_interval_hours.description: How often the background job refreshes OFAC crypto and country lists.
aml.blocklist.sync_interval_hours.example: 24 — sync once per day; 6 for more frequent updates.

aml.blocklist.fail_open.label: Fail open if sync unavailable
aml.blocklist.fail_open.description: When on, empty/stale blocklist DB does not block payouts. When off, missing sync data is treated as high risk.
aml.blocklist.fail_open.example: On for production resilience; off for maximum compliance strictness.

aml.blocklist.use_lists_sanctioned_count.label: Include Lists tab sanctioned countries
aml.blocklist.use_lists_sanctioned_count.description: Merge Lists → sanctioned countries into country blocklist checks (in addition to OFAC sync and manual).
aml.blocklist.use_lists_sanctioned_count.example: Add IR in Lists tab + enable this → Iranian players hit sanctioned_country.

aml.blocklist.crypto_hit_score.label: Payout blocklist hit score
aml.blocklist.crypto_hit_score.description: Risk score added when any payout destination (crypto/bank/e-wallet/card) matches a blocklist entry.
aml.blocklist.crypto_hit_score.example: 90 — usually pushes decision toward block when combined with other signals.

aml.blocklist.country_hit_score.label: Country blocklist hit score
aml.blocklist.country_hit_score.description: Risk score when player country matches blocklist.
aml.blocklist.country_hit_score.example: 90 — default; lower to 70 if you prefer challenge over block.

aml.blocklist.manual_crypto_wallets.label: Manual crypto wallets
aml.blocklist.manual_crypto_wallets.description: Extra wallet addresses to block — one per line. Checked on crypto payouts in addition to OFAC sync.

aml.blocklist.manual_bank_accounts.label: Manual bank accounts
aml.blocklist.manual_bank_accounts.description: IBANs or bank account identifiers to block — one per line.

aml.blocklist.manual_ewallet_accounts.label: Manual e-wallet accounts
aml.blocklist.manual_ewallet_accounts.description: E-wallet ids or emails to block — one per line.

aml.blocklist.manual_card_accounts.label: Manual card payouts
aml.blocklist.manual_card_accounts.description: Card tokens or payout references to block — one per line.

aml.blocklist.manual_countries.label: Manual blocklisted countries
aml.blocklist.manual_countries.description: Countries to block on signup/login/deposit/withdraw. Merged with OFAC sync and Lists tab.
aml.blocklist.manual_countries.example: Select IR, KP, SY — players from those countries hit blocklisted_country when screening is on.

withdrawal_method.enabled.label: Enabled
withdrawal_method.enabled.description: When off, shared payout destination checks are skipped.
withdrawal_method.enabled.example: Requires payment_method_type + payment_method_key on every payment.withdraw evaluate.

withdrawal_method.distinct_users_medium.label: Distinct users (medium)
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_medium.description: How many different user_ids must withdraw to the same payout key before medium tier fires.
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_medium.example: 2 — user A and user B both withdraw to IBAN DE89… → shared_withdrawal_method.

withdrawal_method.distinct_users_high.label: Distinct users (high)
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_high.description: Distinct users threshold for high tier multi-account payout abuse.
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_high.example: 3 — three accounts sharing one Skrill email.

withdrawal_method.distinct_users_critica.label: Distinct users (critical)
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_critica.description: Distinct users threshold for critical tier — usually forces block when listed as a hard-block signal on the Decision tab.
withdrawal_method.distinct_users_critica.example: 4 — four accounts, same crypto wallet → multi_account_shared_withdrawal_method (hard block).

withdrawal_method.medium_score.label: Medium score
withdrawal_method.medium_score.description: Risk score added when distinct-users medium threshold is reached.
withdrawal_method.medium_score.example: 35 — combined with other engines to reach challenge/high.

withdrawal_method.high_score.label: High score
withdrawal_method.high_score.description: Risk score added when distinct-users high threshold is reached.

withdrawal_method.critical_score.label: Critical score
withdrawal_method.critical_score.description: Risk score added when distinct-users critical threshold is reached.
withdrawal_method.critical_score.example: 80 — often enough alone to block if decision threshold is ≤80.

betting_patterns.enabled.label: Enabled
betting_patterns.enabled.description: Master toggle for sequential burst counters and win-rate ratio checks.
betting_patterns.enabled.example: Off disables all signals in this tab.

betting_patterns.burst_window_seconds.label: Burst window (seconds)
betting_patterns.burst_window_seconds.description: Rolling time window for all burst counters and win-rate calculation.
betting_patterns.burst_window_seconds.example: 300 — 10 game.bets in 5 minutes counts toward burst; window slides on each event.

betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_medium.label: game.bet burst — medium
betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_medium.description: Sequential game.bet events in window before medium burst signal.

betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_high.label: game.bet burst — high
betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_high.description: Sequential game.bet count for high tier burst.

betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_critical.label: game.bet burst — critical
betting_patterns.game_bet_burst_critical.description: Sequential game.bet count for critical tier burst.

betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_medium.label: wallet.bet burst — medium
betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_medium.description: Sequential wallet.bet (real-money) events in window before medium burst.

betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_high.label: wallet.bet burst — high
betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_high.description: Sequential wallet.bet count for high tier.

betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_critic.label: wallet.bet burst — critical
betting_patterns.wallet_bet_burst_critic.description: Sequential wallet.bet count for critical tier.

betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_medium.label: wallet.win burst — medium
betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_medium.description: Sequential wallet.win credits in window before medium win burst.
betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_medium.example: 8 — many wins credited in quick succession.

betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_high.label: wallet.win burst — high
betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_high.description: Sequential wallet.win count for high tier.

betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_critic.label: wallet.win burst — critical
betting_patterns.wallet_win_burst_critic.description: Sequential wallet.win count for critical tier.

betting_patterns.win_rate_min_bets.label: Win rate — min bets
betting_patterns.win_rate_min_bets.description: Minimum wallet.bet + game.bet count in window before win-rate ratio is evaluated.
betting_patterns.win_rate_min_bets.example: 5 — need at least 5 bets; 4 wins / 4 bets is ignored until 5th bet arrives.

betting_patterns.win_rate_high_ratio.label: Win rate — high ratio
betting_patterns.win_rate_high_ratio.description: Wins ÷ bets ratio that triggers high win-rate signal (0–1).
betting_patterns.win_rate_high_ratio.example: 0.75 — 6 wins out of 8 bets (75%) in window raises high_win_rate_in_betting_sequence.

betting_patterns.win_rate_critical_ratio.label: Win rate — critical ratio
betting_patterns.win_rate_critical_ratio.description: Wins ÷ bets ratio for critical win-rate tier.
betting_patterns.win_rate_critical_ratio.example: 0.90 — 9 wins out of 10 bets raises critical_win_rate_in_betting_sequence.

hedge_betting.enabled.label: Enabled
hedge_betting.enabled.description: Master toggle for hedged-round detection and volume-washing ratio.
hedge_betting.enabled.example: Off if you do not send metadata.game.selection and round_id yet.

hedge_betting.window_seconds.label: Stats window (seconds)
hedge_betting.window_seconds.description: Rolling window for counting repeated hedged rounds and gross volume ratio.
hedge_betting.window_seconds.example: 3600 — count hedged rounds in the last hour per user.

hedge_betting.round_leg_ttl_seconds.label: Round leg TTL (seconds)
hedge_betting.round_leg_ttl_seconds.description: How long the first bet leg is stored while waiting for the opposite side on the same round_id.
hedge_betting.round_leg_ttl_seconds.example: 600 — banker bet at 12:00:00; player bet at 12:09:59 still matches; at 12:10:01 leg expires.

hedge_betting.time_pair_window_seconds.label: Time-pair window (seconds)
hedge_betting.time_pair_window_seconds.description: Fallback grouping bucket when round_id is missing but table_id is present — bets within this window on same table may pair.
hedge_betting.time_pair_window_seconds.example: 15 — only used if require_round_id is off and round_id absent.

hedge_betting.require_round_id.label: Require round_id
hedge_betting.require_round_id.description: When on, hedge checks run only if metadata.game.round_id is present. Recommended once your backend sends round_id.
hedge_betting.require_round_id.example: On in production — avoids false positives from time-pair fallback.

hedge_betting.opposite_selection_groups.label: Opposite selection groups
hedge_betting.opposite_selection_groups.description: JSON array of groups. Selections in the same inner array are treated as opposites on the same round.

hedge_betting.amount_match_tolerance_per.label: Amount match tolerance (%)
hedge_betting.amount_match_tolerance_per.description: Opposite legs must have stakes within this percentage of each other.
hedge_betting.amount_match_tolerance_per.example: 10 — banker €1000 + player €950 matches; player €800 does not.

hedge_betting.opposite_side_same_round_s.label: Score — opposite sides same round
hedge_betting.opposite_side_same_round_s.description: Risk score when a single hedged round (opposite sides, matching amounts) is detected.
hedge_betting.opposite_side_same_round_s.example: 50 — fires on first detected banker+player pair.

hedge_betting.hedged_round_medium.label: Hedged rounds — medium
hedge_betting.hedged_round_medium.description: Distinct hedged rounds in stats window before repeated-pattern signal (medium tier).
hedge_betting.hedged_round_medium.example: 3 — three separate hedged hands in one hour.

hedge_betting.hedged_round_high.label: Hedged rounds — high
hedge_betting.hedged_round_high.description: Distinct hedged rounds for high tier.

hedge_betting.hedged_round_critical.label: Hedged rounds — critical
hedge_betting.hedged_round_critical.description: Distinct hedged rounds for critical tier.

hedge_betting.volume_washing_enabled.label: Volume washing check
hedge_betting.volume_washing_enabled.description: When on, compare hedged gross bet volume to total gross bet volume in the stats window.
hedge_betting.volume_washing_enabled.example: Player bets €6000 hedged + €4000 normal in 1h → 60% hedged share.

hedge_betting.min_gross_volume.label: Volume washing — min gross
hedge_betting.min_gross_volume.description: Minimum total bet volume in window before volume-washing ratio is evaluated.
hedge_betting.min_gross_volume.example: 5000 — ignore ratio until player has at least €5000 gross bets in window.

hedge_betting.min_hedged_gross_ratio.label: Volume washing — min hedged ratio
hedge_betting.min_hedged_gross_ratio.description: Minimum hedged_gross ÷ total_gross ratio (0–1) to trigger volume washing signal.
hedge_betting.min_hedged_gross_ratio.example: 0.5 — 50% or more of gross volume is hedged → hedged_bet_volume_washing (hard block if listed on Decision tab).

hedge_betting.volume_washing_score.label: Score — volume washing
hedge_betting.volume_washing_score.description: Risk score added when volume-washing ratio threshold is met.
hedge_betting.volume_washing_score.example: 55 — combine with opposite_side score for higher total.

step_up_verification.enabled.label: Enabled
step_up_verification.enabled.description: When off, step_up_verification metadata is ignored and challenge outcomes are not downgraded.
step_up_verification.enabled.example: On when your frontend shows Turnstile on challenge responses.

step_up_verification.grant_ttl_days.label: Grant duration (days)
step_up_verification.grant_ttl_days.description: How long a successful verification grant lasts for the same user_id + device fingerprint.
step_up_verification.grant_ttl_days.example: 7 — player passes Turnstile once; subsequent logins allow for 7 days on same device.

step_up_verification.max_verified_age_mi.label: Max verified_at age (minutes)
step_up_verification.max_verified_age_mi.description: metadata.verified_at must be within this many minutes of the evaluate request timestamp.
step_up_verification.max_verified_age_mi.example: 5 — siteverify at 12:00, evaluate at 12:06 → grant rejected as stale.

step_up_verification.downgrade_challenge.label: Downgrade challenge to allow
step_up_verification.downgrade_challenge.description: When on, active grant changes challenge decision to allow. Never overrides block or critical signals.
step_up_verification.downgrade_challenge.example: On — typical production setting after Turnstile pass.

step_up_verification.allowed_hostnames.label: Allowed hostnames
step_up_verification.allowed_hostnames.description: Optional Cloudflare hostname allowlist from siteverify response — one per line. Empty = skip check.

step_up_verification.applicable_event_ty.label: Applicable event types
step_up_verification.applicable_event_ty.description: Event types where step-up grant can downgrade challenge — one per line.

fingerprint.required_channels.label: Required channels
fingerprint.required_channels.description: Channels where context.fingerprint is expected. Missing value on these channels raises missing_fingerprint.
fingerprint.required_channels.example: web,mobile — signup on web without visitorId → missing_fingerprint.

fingerprint.min_length.label: Min length
fingerprint.min_length.description: Minimum valid FingerprintJS visitorId character length.

fingerprint.max_length.label: Max length
fingerprint.max_length.description: Maximum valid visitorId length. Values outside min–max are rejected.

fingerprint.suspicious_values.label: Suspicious values
fingerprint.suspicious_values.description: Known fake or placeholder fingerprint strings — one per line. Exact match fails validation.

lists.disposable_domains.label: Disposable email domains
lists.disposable_domains.description: Throwaway email provider domains. Signup with these domains is usually hard-blocked.

lists.high_risk_countries.label: High-risk countries
lists.high_risk_countries.description: Countries with elevated fraud rates. Adds score on geo/IP checks — not an automatic block.
lists.high_risk_countries.example: Select NG, GH, PK — raises high_risk_country on matching geo/IP context.

lists.sanctioned_countries.label: Sanctioned countries
lists.sanctioned_countries.description: Sanctioned or gambling-prohibited jurisdictions. Used when AML blocklist includes Lists tab.
lists.sanctioned_countries.example: Select IR, KP, CU — raises sanctioned_country on money events and login.

lists.generic_names.label: Generic names
lists.generic_names.description: Placeholder display names on signup/identity — one per line, case-insensitive.

lists.role_based_email_locals.label: Role-based email locals
lists.role_based_email_locals.description: Email local parts (before @) that indicate non-personal accounts.

lists.suspicious_email_tlds.label: Suspicious email TLDs
lists.suspicious_email_tlds.description: Top-level domains associated with spam. Match when email ends with these TLDs.

lists.suspicious_email_local_tokens.label: Suspicious email local tokens
lists.suspicious_email_local_tokens.description: Substrings in email local part that suggest throwaway or bot accounts.

lists.bot_user_agent_tokens.label: Bot user-agent tokens
lists.bot_user_agent_tokens.description: Substrings in User-Agent header indicating scripts or automation.

lists.emulator_ua_tokens.label: Emulator UA tokens
lists.emulator_ua_tokens.description: User-Agent patterns for Android emulators or virtual devices.

lists.suspicious_referrers.label: Suspicious referrers
lists.suspicious_referrers.description: Exact referrer values treated as low-trust on signup.

lists.bonus_abuse_referrer_tokens.label: Bonus abuse referrer tokens
lists.bonus_abuse_referrer_tokens.description: Substrings in signup referrer URL linked to bonus-hunting or affiliate abuse sites.

velocity_thresholds.label: Velocity thresholds (JSON)
velocity_thresholds.description: Map of threshold name → max count. Suffix _medium/_high/_critical selects tier. Do not delete keys — engines expect the full set.

critical_signals.label: Hard-block signals
critical_signals.description: Exact signal name strings emitted by engines — one per line. Must match case exactly.

features.sync_publish_audit.label: Publish audit on sync /evaluate
features.sync_publish_audit.description: When on, synchronous POST /evaluate results are also published to RabbitMQ for Orchestrator audit.
features.sync_publish_audit.example: On when Orchestrator must see sync API decisions in the same pipeline as async events.

features.decision_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Decision cache TTL (seconds)
features.decision_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache identical event_id decisions in Redis to avoid re-scoring duplicates. Requires Redis enabled.
features.decision_cache_ttl_seconds.example: 300 — same event_id within 5 minutes returns cached decision; 0 = disabled.

features.redis_enabled.label: Redis enabled
features.redis_enabled.description: Use Redis for velocity counters, hedge/betting stores, and optional decision cache.
features.redis_enabled.example: Off for single-instance dev (in-memory counters); on for production multi-instance.

features.redis_velocity_ip_ttl.label: Redis IP velocity TTL
features.redis_velocity_ip_ttl.description: Sliding window length (seconds) for IP-based velocity keys in Redis.
features.redis_velocity_ip_ttl.example: 3600 — login_ip_high counts logins from one IP in the last hour.

features.redis_velocity_domain_ttl.label: Redis domain velocity TTL
features.redis_velocity_domain_ttl.description: Sliding window length for email-domain signup velocity counters.
features.redis_velocity_domain_ttl.example: 86400 — signup_domain_* counts signups per domain in 24h.

features.rabbitmq_enabled.label: RabbitMQ consumer enabled
features.rabbitmq_enabled.description: Start async consumer that scores events from the casino platform exchange/queue.
features.rabbitmq_enabled.example: On when platform publishes wallet.bet, player.login, etc. to casino.events.

features.rabbitmq_publish_results.label: Publish results to Orchestrator
features.rabbitmq_publish_results.description: Publish scored EvaluateResponse messages to the results queue after async scoring.
features.rabbitmq_publish_results.example: On when Orchestrator subscribes to risk.results for audit/actions.

features.rabbitmq_events_exchange.label: Events exchange
features.rabbitmq_events_exchange.description: Topic exchange the casino platform publishes to. Empty = legacy direct queue mode.

features.rabbitmq_events_exchange_type.label: Exchange type
features.rabbitmq_events_exchange_type.description: RabbitMQ exchange type declared/bound by AFS consumer.

features.rabbitmq_events_queue.label: Events queue
features.rabbitmq_events_queue.description: Queue AFS consumes from after binding to the platform exchange.

features.rabbitmq_events_binding_key.label: Binding key
features.rabbitmq_events_binding_key.description: Routing key pattern for queue binding. # = all messages on exchange.
features.rabbitmq_events_binding_key.example: # — all events; player.* — only player routing keys.

features.rabbitmq_prefetch.label: Prefetch count
features.rabbitmq_prefetch.description: Max unacknowledged messages per consumer channel.

features.rabbitmq_results_queue.label: Results queue
features.rabbitmq_results_queue.description: Outbound queue name for scored async results.

logging.sync_enabled.label: Sync request/response logging
logging.sync_enabled.description: Store full request and response payloads for POST /evaluate in Postgres. View under Log viewer below.
logging.sync_enabled.example: Enable during integration testing; disable in high-volume production if storage is a concern.

logging.async_enabled.label: Async request/response logging
logging.async_enabled.description: Store RabbitMQ scored/skipped/rejected/failed messages with payloads where available.
logging.async_enabled.example: Enable to debug casino.events → AFS pipeline without tailing container logs.
